BiblicalUsage: Rachmaniy means compassionate, tender-hearted — the women who were pitiful. Jeremiah says, 'The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.'
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the verse is the lowest point of the siege: when compassion itself is driven to do the unthinkable, you know how far the judgment has gone.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
